review_checks.detail: Bool/non-numeric/nonfinite/negative or degenerate boxes and nonpositive fonts reject. Numeric conversion overflow rejects; every derived normalized ratio including heights must be finite before proof. Output contains only finite measured coordinates/scalars and bounded enum/count, not raw text or invented IDs.

Width/indent/tail/bodyratio/gap/height/rightedge are jointly required. Negative overlap is reported honestly as new native_indented_terminal_tail basis, not an old overlap pass. No claim that shape proves source/page/column/speaker/semantic assertion.

Left must end in actual CJK and not existing terminator, tail must contain1..3nonnumeric actual CJK plus accepted terminator/closing quote within4codepoints; Latin/digit/numeric CJK/footnote-like numeric/missing comma/ellipsis/internal-space/excess tail cases reject. Both source strings remain unchanged.

Hard maximum2048/4characters bounds text work. Thresholds are font-relative and translation/scale-invariant, not company/source/page/text special cases. Documented one real measured shape and synthetic boundary/negative controls support this narrow observer, not broad source/column error rate claims.

Independently executed70 tests, including both actual negative-overlap sample and just-inside/outside geometry, invalid data, tall/thin bbox, overflow ratio, Unicode numeric ideograph, no mutation and actual-worktree import checks.

mandatory_integration_constraints: Call only after original/page/scope/frame/font/consecutive ordinal+paragraph and table/heading/role barriers have passed; the helper has no inputs with which to validate these.

A missing/unknown column label equal to another missing label is not positive same-column evidence. In particular, the new negative-overlap branch must not silently discard the old overlap rule spatial protection. Establish actual native layout/flow compatibility under the source owner; otherwise remain unknown/defer.
Return only physical edge evidence; do not label semantic subject/antecedent/word closure as proven, or manufacture/repair original text.
Bind new helper version plus actual source dependency into current production causal/cache identity. Keep old paid/source receipts immutable.

Production connector needs same-source/page/frame/font/column and nonconsecutive/heading/table/role negative controls, plus actual original/ref/text/coordinate replay. Pure helper tests do not substitute these.

independent_execution.environment: minimal system/runtime variables; plugins autoload and dotenv disabled; no environment objects output

limitations: No production connector/source parser or final source-readiness claim reviewed here.
No independent real original/PDF inspection; calibration inspected through the bounded handed-off measurement and tests.
No full suite, actual source/C rerun, API/model/network, original/config mutation or environment/credential output.
